moments.selftext: BREAKING: US M2 money supply surged +$102.8 billion in July, to a record $23.22 trillion. This marks the 27th consecutive monthly increase. Since the start of 2026, M2 has now risen +$862.7 billion. Furthermore, money supply now stands $1.43 trillion above the March 2022 peak. Since 2000, money in circulation has grown at an average annual rate of +6.3%, or ~$700 billion a year. US money creation is expanding at a rapid pace.

moments.title: LOOK OUTSIDE

Dolly Parton in Polaroid photographs taken by Andy Warhol. In 1985, Andy Warhol photographed country music legend Dolly Parton using his Polaroid Big Shot camera, capturing her instantly recognizable features in a series
moments.selftext: Dolly Parton in Polaroid photographs taken by Andy Warhol. In 1985, Andy Warhol photographed country music legend Dolly Parton using his Polaroid Big Shot camera, capturing her instantly recognizable features in a series of Polacolor prints. The images emphasized Parton’s platinum-blonde hair, dramatic makeup, and unmistakable smile. Warhol often used these instant photographs as more than just finished images. They served as reference and layout studies for his iconic silkscreen portraits, helping him develop the compositions for his later works. The collaboration brought together Parton’s larger-than-life country glamour and Warhol’s distinctive pop art style, producing a memorable series of high-contrast portraits that have since become part of major museum collections.
